categories.title: Indoor plants
categories.description: Explore indoor plants for rooms, offices and sheltered spaces. Ask our Pattoki nursery about suitable plants and current availability.

categories.title: Outdoor plants
categories.description: Browse outdoor plants for gardens, courtyards and open spaces, including shrubs and ornamental greenery.

categories.title: Fruit plants
categories.description: Explore fruit plants and young trees for home gardens and orchards. Contact the nursery about varieties, sizes and prices.

categories.title: Bonsai
categories.description: Discover bonsai and shaped miniature trees for terraces, courtyards and indoor spaces. Contact us to confirm availability.

categories.title: Cactus plants
categories.description: Browse cactus plants and succulents for bright windows, patios and rock gardens. Ask the nursery about available varieties.

categories.title: Flowering plants
categories.description: Explore flowering plants for pots, garden borders and landscaping. Ask our nursery about seasonal selection and availability.

categories.title: Palms
categories.description: Browse palms for entrances, terraces and larger gardens, including the nursery’s Royal, Sylvester and Alexandra palms.

categories.title: Trees
categories.description: Explore trees for gardens, avenues and landscape projects, including Terminalia, Jamun and Pink Tabebuia.

categories.title: Topiary art
categories.description: Discover shaped plants and living sculptures, from Buxus cones and spirals to animal topiary for gardens and landscape projects.

categories.title: Shrubs and hedges
categories.description: Explore shrubs and hedging plants for garden borders, screens and outdoor spaces. Contact the nursery to check availability.
